verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a Git hosting product, but nothing in the evidence shows Gitea itself accepting or interpreting natural-language commands. The official MCP server (gitea-probe-3) is evidence for the separate MCP-server story: it exposes tools to an external AI agent, and that agent does the language understanding. The tea CLI, REST API and Swagger docs are structured-command and developer building blocks, not natural-language interfaces, so none of these earn credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
